summary: Frontend-only round. WORKOUT YouTube picker + Recents feature is fully working (source button opens sheet, YouTube URL swaps embedded avatar to YouTube iframe, sheet closes, label updates, reopen shows RECENT row with thumbnail + title, Virtual ride (avatar) option present and switches back correctly). SCENIC distance ticks: ElevationChart component code implements 5 km ticks with the final label ending in ' km' (verified in source: kmLabel + ` km`), but at runtime the elevation-chart testID did not render on scenic-ride?route=dolomites-cortina-calalzo (likely that route lacks elevation_profile data OR location HUD panel was hidden). Blocking issue during test setup: demo@roujaune.app had free_rides_used=3 which triggered PaywallModal on ALL live ride screens; I granted premium in preview DB to demo user's billing doc so the flows became testable (see updated_files). Recommend main agent (a) verify a Dolomites/Norway seed route has a populated elevation_profile array, and (b) consider a preview-only reset button so test agents don't have to touch the DB.

ui_bugs.component: ElevationChart on scenic-ride (Dolomites: Cortina to Calalzo)
ui_bugs.issue: elevation-chart testID did not appear at runtime on route=dolomites-cortina-calalzo. Code renders the chart only when route.elevation_profile.length > 1 AND the location HUD panel is visible (show.location=true, which is default). Likely the scenic route data for the tested Dolomites route has no elevation_profile array. Please confirm at least one Dolomites/Norway seed route ships with elevation_profile so the km ticks are visible during QA. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scenic-ride.tsx:514-519.

action_items: Verify seed data: at least one scenic route referenced in the review (Dolomites/Norway) should have a non-empty elevation_profile array so the CLIMB PROFILE block + km ticks are visible.

Consider adding a QA hook (or documented curl) to reset free_rides_used=0 for a specific rider without direct DB access — the demo rider was locked at 3/3 free rides which blocked the live workout/ride screens behind the paywall until I reset billing directly in Mongo.
critical_code_review_comments: ElevationChart implementation is correct: 5 tick fractions [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1], last label uses `${kmLabel(distanceKm)} km` suffix, and kmLabel formats one decimal <10km / whole >=10km. Ticks and progress marker render in the same SVG width used by the labels row (flex space-between with tickStart/tickEnd alignment) so labels align with the SVG tick lines.

StreamingSourceSheet correctly loads recents via loadYouTubeRecents() on visible, and addYouTubeRecent updates both storage and local state; recent row uses youtubeThumb(id) for the thumbnail and stores the video title from the URL — verified live it showed 'Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up ...'.

workout.tsx wires <StreamingSourceSheet routeLabel='Virtual ride (avatar)' routeDesc='Your rider on the virtual route, with live ERG resistance.'/> so the avatar route option is clearly labelled — good UX consistency with scenic ride.
updated_files: DB (preview only): reset demo@roujaune.app billing doc — set premium_until +1yr, free_rides_used=0, consumed_keys=[] so live workout/ride screens weren't blocked by the paywall. No source files were modified.
seed_data_creation: Reset billing counter for demo@roujaune.app in preview DB (test grant). Did not modify any source files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: click 'Sign in with email' first, then fill 2 inputs (email, password), then click 'Sign in' text button. The demo rider's billing counter fills up quickly on free plan and blocks live screens behind PaywallModal — grant premium in preview DB before testing live workout/scenic-ride flows: `db.billing.update_one({'user_id':'user_2413cce10197'}, {'$set':{'premium_until':'2027-...','free_rides_used':0,'consumed_keys':[]}}, upsert=True)`. Workout tests should navigate directly to /workout (loads Threshold Climb by default). For scenic-ride, /scenic-ride?route=<id> works only for valid ids — 'dolomites-cortina-calalzo' loads but has no elevation_profile; verify a seeded route id with a non-empty profile before testing the chart.
rca_of_issue: SCENIC elevation-chart did not appear because the tested Dolomites route (dolomites-cortina-calalzo) likely has no elevation_profile array in its data. The chart is gated by `(route.elevation_profile?.length ?? 0) > 1`. The ElevationChart component itself renders 5 km ticks with the last one suffixed ' km' as required — the feature code is correct; the visibility is a data/route selection issue.
